source_snapshot.items: Check Profile settings on BMC web
source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC Web Profile settings read User Privilege and Timezone display preference, press F5, and check both again.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 5 attended/5 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; captures privilege/timezone before/after F5 but does not define expected values or account/session identity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/LOW; requires approved account/target, authoritative role/timezone, same-session evidence, safe F5 and no secret exposure.

old_problem: Readable values are not necessarily correct, and unchanged strings may belong to the wrong account or cached/default state. Authoritative privilege/timezone references, normalization and same-session F5 semantics were missing but are normal project configuration.
disposition_reason: The two fields and one F5 action are explicit. ED-06/15/20 allow the approved account, effective role mapping, timezone/locale/DST normalization and browser behavior as runtime inputs. Real BMC Web before/after evidence remains required, with backend reads as corroboration rather than substitution.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2244, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2245 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00027-V001 / 082a24ce32a1e9dc was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Bind the exact BMC/WebUI/browser and approved test account/role; root is used only if specifically authorized.
Define authoritative effective privilege and backend mapping plus canonical timezone/offset/DST/locale representation.
From a read-only Profile page, capture non-secret account marker, literal/DOM User Privilege and Timezone display preference plus approved backend corroboration.
Ensure no unsaved form can be resubmitted; press F5 exactly once and verify same BMC/account/session continuity without hidden re-login.
Recapture both fields and compare literal plus normalized values to the authoritative references and pre-F5 state.
Never capture cookies/tokens/passwords or edit privilege/timezone/profile; stop on logout, CSRF, wrong target/account or unexpected submit/value change.
No login, GUI/API read, F5, profile change, relogin, retry or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: BMC Web profile privilege/timezone correctness and F5 persistence
test_case.purpose: Verify that the authenticated account's displayed effective privilege and timezone preference are correct and remain readable/unchanged after one full F5 reload in the same authorized session.
required_package: BMC/WebUI/supported browser and approved account identity
Expected timezone zone/offset/DST/locale value and normalization
Safe read-only Profile page, session/F5 behavior, protected access and final cleanup
test_case.test_command: In the verified same-target account session, capture non-secret Profile account marker, User Privilege and Timezone preference plus approved backend references, press F5 once on a safe non-submitting view, verify no re-login/target change, recapture both fields, and compare literal and normalized values without editing.
test_case.expected_result: Before and after F5, the same authenticated account/target remains active; privilege and timezone are readable, match authoritative normalized values, and do not change unexpectedly; no form is submitted or profile value mutated.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires real before/after WebUI evidence, same session/account/target, authoritative privilege/timezone agreement and safe single F5. Readable-only, cached/default, wrong-account, hidden relogin or backend-only evidence cannot pass. Missing references blocks execution, not review.
safety_gate: Verify target/account and safe non-submitting Profile state before F5.
Protect credentials/cookies/tokens and sensitive profile data.
No profile, privilege, timezone, password or session-policy edit; no repeated relogin/retry.
Stop on wrong account/target, logout/CSRF, ambiguous values, form submission or unexpected change.
expected_evidence: Secret-safe before-F5 full/DOM profile values and backend corroboration
Secret-safe after-F5 target/account/session plus both field values
Literal/normalized comparison, no-submit/no-change audit and cleanup
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected. On logout or unexpected submit/value change, preserve evidence, do not relogin repeatedly or edit the profile, and use the approved session/recovery owner to restore final state.

source_conflict.reason: The row consistently requires both profile fields to remain correct/readable across F5; root is an example requiring approval.

blocked.reason: The GUI workflow is clear; account/reference/normalization inputs are parameterizable.
